question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the human eye?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cochlea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **The human eye** is a sensory organ that responds to visible light and allows humans to use visual information for a variety of reasons, including perceiving things, maintaining balance, and keeping our circadian rhythm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The cornea** is the transparent outer layer of the eye that covers the entire front of the eye. The cornea aids in the focus of light in your eye, allowing you to see clearly. 
 
• **The ciliary muscle** is an intrinsic eye muscle that is developed as a ring of smooth muscle in the central layer of the eye, called the uvea (vascular layer).
 
 
• **The iris **is a thin, annular structure in the eye that regulates the size and diameter of the pupil, and thus the amount of light that reaches the retina.
